proposals.handwrittenRationale: The partial model outside src/Generated explicitly declares the internal member; it is not an empty type extension.

proposals.handwrittenRationale: The model source outside src/Generated provides explicit CodeGenType metadata and a concretely typed property.

proposals.explanation: Suppresses the generated three-argument authentication-policy constructor; the settings constructor creates the policy and forwards endpoint, options and credential provider to a four-argument overload that initializes ClientConnectionProvider with a 100-entry capacity, stores the provider and builds the pipeline. The protected mocking constructor also initializes that base capacity.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The explicit constructor suppression and all replacement/chaining bodies appear outside src/Generated; base initialization and token-provider retention are visible in code.

proposals.subtype: Token-provider constructor with project pipeline policies
proposals.explanation: Adds two token-provider constructor overloads, validates endpoint/provider, retains client settings, and builds a BearerTokenPolicy pipeline. Construction installs conditional api-version injection excluding openai/v1 paths, a fixed Foundry-Features header, a telemetry-derived User-Agent, a generated request ID header, and the named OpenAI transform/parity policy helpers. UserAgentApplicationId is a public option whose setter checks that options are not frozen and whose value feeds telemetry construction.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The constructor bodies and option property are source outside src/Generated. Their validation, policy installation and freeze-checked option setter are executable code, not inferred from dependencies.

proposals.subtype: Connection-provider lookup bridge and cache capacity
proposals.explanation: Implements hidden ClientConnectionProvider overrides by delegating single/all connection lookups to ClientConnectionCacheManager. The token-provider constructor creates that manager using endpoint, pipeline and provider and supplies options.ClientCacheSize to the base; the internal option defaults to 100.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The provider overrides, manager construction and capacity option are explicit source outside src/Generated. Only delegation and configuration are reported; the manager implementation is not supplied.

proposals.explanation: Adds lazy thread-safe subclient getters using Volatile.Read and Interlocked.CompareExchange and exposes operation-client properties. Most constructors reuse diagnostics, pipeline, endpoint and API version; the dataset client also receives the token provider, the agent client receives the tracing option, and OpenAI/agent clients are obtained through their project factories. The MemoryStores property calls GetAIProjectMemoryStoresClient, not the differently named operation getter defined here.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: All listed getter and property implementations are in the client source outside src/Generated; their lazy initialization and argument forwarding are directly visible.

proposals.subtype: Realtime subclient requiring a token provider
proposals.explanation: Creates and caches the realtime client with endpoint, retained token provider, first auth flow, API version and feature headers, forwarding logging/tracing options. Throws InvalidOperationException with construction guidance when no provider is available, and exposes the client through ProjectsRealtimeClient.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The credential-availability guard, subclient construction and public accessor are executable client source outside src/Generated.

proposals.subtype: Telemetry client bound to the project client

proposals.handwrittenRationale: The property implementation outside src/Generated explicitly constructs the telemetry client rather than only declaring a generated member.

decisions.reason: Line 12 marks this public partial type experimental; the file is outside Generated. The larger cited range also contains unrelated suppressions, but the annotation is directly evidenced.

Lines 13–16 suppress all four signatures, and 35–65 construct the sync and async typed collection results with order conversion. This is a paged-result API adaptation, not evidence that these methods implement the page loop.

Lines 17–20 suppress the typed and protocol signatures, and 79–121 explicitly validate monitorId and construct typed sync/async results after converting the enum filters; no implementation of pagination is claimed.
Lines 21–24 suppress the four signatures, and 137–185 show the replacement result construction, conversions, forwarding and monitorId validation.
The captured partial class adds an internal read-only error member; without the generated class, it does not demonstrate that a generated public member was hidden.

finding.explanation: Adds an internal get-only FoundryOpenAIError member to the AgentInsightRun partial class.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The property declaration is in a source file outside src/Generated, rather than an empty partial type.

decisions.reason: This partial model declares BlobUri as a Uri, but the generated model and underlying wire type were not supplied, so a change from a different generated property type is unproven.

finding.handwrittenRationale: The declared member and CodeGenType attribute are in src/Custom rather than src/Generated.

decisions.reason: Lines 32 and 48–88 show suppression, the settings-to-policy constructor, token-provider retention and base-constructor initialization. The note about why the generated constructor needs suppression is a source comment, not independently established generated-code behavior.

The token-provider constructors establish the auth behavior; the query/header/response policy registrations represent separate behavior and should not be folded into that constructor finding. The option's application ID is used by telemetry during construction.

finding.explanation: Provides endpoint/token-provider constructor overloads, retains the provider and options, initializes the client pipeline with a BearerTokenPolicy, and reads the configurable UserAgentApplicationId when constructing telemetry details.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The two constructor bodies and option property are in src/Custom rather than src/Generated; the bearer-token pipeline and option read are visible in their bodies.

decisions.reason: Lines 103–105, 132–145 and the options declaration demonstrate a bounded cache setting, cache-manager construction and connection lookup delegation; the manager's own caching algorithm is not in this evidence.

The cited client lines show thread-safe cached subclient getters and their public accessors, including the differing MemoryStores getter names as the proposal explicitly notes. That getter's definition is not supplied and should not be assumed.

Lines 258–285 include the missing-token-provider guard, realtime-client construction using the provider and first flow, caching and public accessor; this is a credential-dependent scoped subclient factory.
The property constructs a telemetry helper on every access, not a cached operation subclient. Classify its telemetry-specific purpose rather than treating it as a generic scoped subclient factory.

finding.explanation: The Telemetry property constructs an AIProjectTelemetry object bound to the current project client on each access.
finding.handwrittenRationale: This implemented property, rather than a declaration-only stub, appears in src/Custom outside src/Generated.

decisions.reason: The cited settings constructor and public accessors carry explicit Experimental attributes outside Generated. Other annotated internal helpers in the same file need not be counted separately from the corresponding public feature surface.
Lines 338–340 create and cache a classifier configured with 200 and 201; the proposal does not assert unobserved classification details.
Both overloads are explicitly Obsolete, hidden from normal editor display, and forward while discarding clientRequestId; backward-compatibility-shim and addressable no are supported.

The two public overloads validate the name and dispatch on includeCredentials to corresponding credential-bearing or ordinary operations. The called operations' implementations are outside the evidence.
Lines 101–130 show list iteration, selection by IsDefault, subsequent retrieval and the explicit failure when no default is found, in both sync and async methods.
Four cited signatures carry Obsolete and EditorBrowsable(Never), and each drops clientRequestId when forwarding; this is an observed compatibility shim, not a hypothetical motive.

omissions.subtype: Conditional version and feature request policies
omissions.explanation: The token-provider constructor registers a query-parameter policy for api-version only when the path does not contain openai/v1, plus Foundry-Features, User-Agent and generated request-ID header policies and three named OpenAI transform/parity policy helpers.
omissions.handwrittenRationale: These explicit policy registrations occur in the client constructor under src/Custom, outside src/Generated; the helper implementations are not part of this evidence.

limitations: Only 6 of 780 eligible files were supplied from 967 discovered files. Coverage lists many omitted operation clients, helpers, models, telemetry and realtime implementations.
Collection-result implementations are not supplied. The monitor methods establish typed result construction and parameter conversion, not the actual continuation loop or paging transport.

Pipeline helper implementations, cache-manager internals, generated overload bodies and auth-flow definitions are not supplied. Findings describe visible installation, construction and delegation without inferring their unseen algorithms.
MemoryStores delegates to GetAIProjectMemoryStoresClient; the supplied file defines a differently named GetAIProjectMemoryStoresOperationsClient. No equivalence or unseen implementation is assumed.
The settings constructor path does not visibly initialize the connection manager in the supplied constructor body; no runtime connection-cache behavior for that path is inferred.
The experimental markers are distinct API metadata from the method bodies. Constructor pipeline work on identical overloads is combined into one finding rather than split by each installed policy.
No earlier API binaries are supplied. Compatibility classification for obsolete overloads follows their visible obsolete metadata and forwarding behavior.
Only six of 780 eligible files were captured; this review cannot assess the skipped files or establish the absence of other customizations.

The generated partial definitions, collection-result implementations, connection cache manager, policy helper implementations and referenced subclients were not supplied. Their behavior and precise differences from generated APIs cannot be verified from this request.
The project metadata describes a TypeSpec-generated SDK, but does not independently substantiate every source comment about the generator or compilation.
